units.name: Programme/horizon
units.definition: A named start/end reporting period used consistently for a matched route pair.
units.boundary: Date/window, not an automatic annual subscription.

units.name: Edition
units.definition: One identified research asset/version with actual evidence period and release/rights basis.
units.boundary: A reading path, briefing or city does not automatically create a new edition.

units.name: Customer organisation
units.definition: One distinct purchasing organisation for customer-count reporting.
units.boundary: One organisation can have several actual nonoverlapping orders; do not call each a new customer.

units.name: Order/package
units.definition: One defined billable scope/fee record, possibly containing multiple benefits.
units.boundary: Bundle fee counted once; internal allocation is not extra revenue.

units.name: Standalone licence entitlement
units.definition: One edition/use grant not already provided free or bundled.
units.boundary: User, licence, copy, organisation and channel are different units.

units.name: Briefing/service instance
units.definition: One separately scoped preparation/delivery/follow-up unit where genuinely additional.
units.boundary: No unlimited service or new research inferred.

units.name: Funding partner
units.definition: A distinct organisation supporting a specified purpose under an actual package.
units.boundary: Partner count differs from package/order count and from received funding.

units.name: Unique practitioner
units.definition: One verified eligible person with actual usable permitted report input.
units.boundary: Count once under WP03; an RSVP, suggested question, membership or attended seat is not automatically a report contributor.

units.name: Exploratory Table contribution event
units.definition: One actual substantive exploratory event under the up-to-four research scope.
units.boundary: This is not a future dinner, city event or extra person; combined/repeated-event rules remain in WP03.

units.name: Programme gathering
units.definition: One prospective physical/remote peer/research event in the commercial operating model.
units.boundary: The one-city pilot/four-city annual option is a proposal, not the four exploratory conversations.

units.name: Seat/place
units.definition: One capacity/catering place at a specified gathering, for practitioner, host, moderator or other agreed attendee.
units.boundary: 12–15 practitioner places require additional host/moderator/other seats where needed; capacity is not actual attendance.

units.name: Contribution/account
units.definition: A separately identified input event or account with its actual permitted uses.
units.boundary: Several accounts from one person are not several unique practitioners; published detail may differ from usable analysis.

units.name: Staff work unit
units.definition: Hours by role, work object and period with cash/resource classifications.
units.boundary: Unknown hours/rates are not zero; incremental paid labour cannot be added twice as opportunity time.

units.name: Cash transaction/milestone
units.definition: A dated expected or actual receipt/payment record in its original currency with status.
units.boundary: Contracted, invoiced, due, received, refunded and fulfilled are different states.

units.name: Revenue/benefit fulfilment
units.definition: The specific edition/access, briefing, placement or other benefit delivered under a package.
units.boundary: Planning revenue/fulfilment attribution is defined here; no formal tax/accounting recognition treatment is asserted.

calculations.name: Standalone licence planning revenue
calculations.expression: SUM(net unit fee by defined standalone entitlement × actual/scenario quantity, after applicable explicit discounts/credits)
calculations.conditions: Equivalent free/bundled entitlements excluded; keep original use/version. Quantity/price are not validated demand.

calculations.name: Partner/package planning revenue
calculations.conditions: Do not add included briefing/licence/recognition notional values as extra revenue. Any allocation to benefits is internal and reconciles to package total.

calculations.name: Incremental operating contribution
calculations.expression: Defined planning revenue − attributable operating cash costs for the selected decision/horizon
calculations.conditions: Disclose which committed/initial costs are outside this incremental view. Not a substitute for fully loaded result or bank cash.

calculations.name: Fully loaded planning result
calculations.expression: Defined planning revenue − attributable cash operating costs − additional noncash resource/opportunity cost not already counted
calculations.conditions: Use an explicit labour overlap bridge. Staff time cannot disappear, and the same labour cannot be charged twice.

calculations.name: Initial investment-recovery view
calculations.expression: Selected operating/full-resource result − separately identified initial investment not already included in that result
calculations.conditions: Current USD1,500 commission occurs once in the relevant first-project view, with USD1,000/USD500 allocations retained. It is not charged again per city/customer or assumed every future edition cost.

calculations.name: Event increment
calculations.expression: B matched-horizon result − A matched-horizon result
calculations.conditions: Same core research basis/horizon. Incremental sales or partner fees caused by events remain separate untested scenario assumptions; no automatic attribution.

calculations.name: Closing cash
calculations.expression: Opening cash + dated cash receipts − dated cash payments
calculations.conditions: Include actual/planning cash taxes, fees, deposits, refunds and FX settlement basis where applicable; unknown receipts are not confirmed funds.

calculations.name: Peak funding need
calculations.expression: Largest positive funding requirement implied by the cumulative cash path after the explicitly chosen starting-cash basis
calculations.conditions: Track pre-commitment/non-refundable exposure against confirmed and received available funds; monthly aggregation may need finer dates if intramonth exposure is material.

calculations.name: Single-product break-even licence units
calculations.expression: CEILING(MAX(0, relevant fixed funding/cost requirement − net contribution of other included revenues) / positive incremental contribution per standalone licence)
calculations.conditions: Use the same cost/revenue basis. If remaining gap is zero, zero additional units may be needed; if gap is positive and unit contribution is zero/negative, report not achievable with this product rather than divide by zero. Mixed tiers require an explicit fixed sales mix or separate scenario; no hidden average.

calculations.name: Currency conversion
calculations.expression: Original currency amount × dated GBP-per-original-currency rate
calculations.conditions: GBP is proposed reporting currency. Preserve source currency, direction/date and planning vs actual settlement. No rate entered in this design.

calculations.name: Event place requirement
calculations.expression: Practitioner places + host places + moderator places + other actually chosen attendee places
calculations.conditions: Avoid duplicate host/moderator seats where one person performs both roles; preserve catering/room minimum basis separately.

calculations.name: Annual reconciliation
calculations.expression: Common selected-edition/programme work + SUM(city-specific incremental work/cost/receipts)
calculations.conditions: Do not copy common edition production four times. If a genuinely additional edition is selected, add its explicit incremental work once.

tax_basis.note: No VAT/sales-tax advice or recovery assumption. Supplier cash and net economic costs may differ only with an evidenced chosen treatment.

initial_contract_investment.role: Existing signed-scope nominal design facts, not future cost quotes or new financial inputs.
initial_contract_investment.payment_status: Use existing baseline: upfront user-reported; balance trigger under agreement. Do not invent paid/bank receipt dates or final acceptance.
initial_contract_investment.note: Actual sunk/avoidable/payment status is a decision-time question; do not equate the full nominal commission to irrevocable cash already spent.
